technical.summary: MACD crossovers and supertrend show early bullish structure, but price remains below key moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 20.5), negative CMF, and Ichimoku cloud resistance—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: TMO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 9 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (junior members, small trades 87-94 days old) and absent news sentiment provide limited confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (333.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 9 days compounds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD crossovers (12/26/9 and 8/21/5) with supertrend bullish signal early momentum reversal, and extreme fear (23/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity near support (492.49).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages (EMA-21, SMA-21, Hull MA) with weak trend strength (ADX 20.5), negative CMF, Ichimoku cloud resistance, earnings binary in 9 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (333.4), and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unacceptable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: MACD crossovers and supertrend show early bullish structure with price at support (492.49), and extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian opportunity. However, this is insufficient to override severe macro headwinds, earnings binary risk, and weak fundamental conviction.
